note: Single source of truth for the product runtime pins. product/app.Dockerfile ARGs, product/docker-compose.yml service images and the CI runners are guarded against this file by tests/foundation/test_product_packaging.py and the foundation workflows, so they cannot silently drift.

sha256_pinned: node linux-x64 tarball (tarball_sha256; verified by the Product image workflow against nodejs.org SHASUMS256.txt and by the Dockerfile at build)
python runtime artifact (upstream_digest, verified by the Foundation runtime probe)
source files of the pinned upstream commits (source_file_sha256)
tag_pinned: python base image (exact patch tag; the resolved digest is recorded per build by the Product image workflow)
not_locked: Debian bookworm OS packages: current bookworm set at image-build time (apt is not version-pinned)
resolved Python dependency set: bench-managed per pinned upstream pyproject files; consistency verified with `uv pip check` at build and in CI

components.name: frappe
components.selection_reason: Newest non-prerelease v16 release observed; common framework for the app bundle.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.

components.name: erpnext
components.selection_reason: Newest non-prerelease v16 release observed; requires Frappe >=16.21,<17, satisfied by candidate source version.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.

components.name: education
components.selection_reason: Newest non-prerelease v16 Education release observed. Prefer release commit over Phase 1 moving-branch snapshot.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.
components.note: Upstream release-tag/source mismatch: tag v16.1.0, source __version__ 16.0.1. The pinned commit is authoritative; the runtime reports 16.0.1. Upstream advisory triage for this component's npm packages remains open (recorded in the selection reason history); no value here is a security verdict.

components.selection_reason: Pinned to Phase 1 Bench develop requirement for initial bootstrap; NOT a qualified tool for downloading selected Python 3.14.7. Automatic resolution attempted older 3.14.4.
